speaker: Doctor
text: That description of symptoms is very specific for a newborn. The combination of a continuous murmur, non-blanching skin lesions (petechiae/purpura), and cloudy lenses (cataracts) is highly suggestive of a congenital infection, possibly Rubella or Cytomegalovirus, rather than cellulitis which typically presents with localized redness and warmth. REQUEST TEST: CBC with Differential, Blood_Culture, and TORCH_Serology. Can you confirm the baby's gestational age and if there were any prenatal infections?
